about.title: About
about.subtitle: A personal project built by a climber, for climbers.

story.title: The Story
story.content: Crimp Studio started as a learning project to explore Three.js, procedural generation, and AI. I wanted to build a tool that helps climbers generate new routes without tedious manual work. Most existing solutions require expensive hardware or are too limited. So I built this.

step1.title: 1. Configure Your Wall
step1.description: Set dimensions and inclination angle to match your real wall.

step2.title: 2. Generate or Place Holds
step2.description: Let the algorithm create a complete boulder, or place holds manually.

step3.title: 3. Get Route Suggestions
step3.description: A genetic algorithm generates climbable routes with estimated grades.
